plain_english: Before my own master, treasure of victory-fortune — may I taste for a moment the nectar of victory-proclamation.
sanskrit_cite: jayalakṣmīnidhānasya nijasya svāminaḥ puraḥ jayodghoṣaṇapīyūṣarasam āsvādaye kṣaṇam

plain_english: Victory: one Rudra, one Śiva, great god, great Lord — Pārvatī's lover, Śarva, eldest of all gods.
sanskrit_cite: jayaikarudraikaśiva mahādeva maheśvara pārvatīpraṇayiñ śarva sarvagīrvāṇapūrvaja

plain_english: Victory: moon-mark-eyed sole mark of the three-worlds-Lord; victory: poison-mark-throated, who drank the black poison for the worlds' pain.
Victory: whose self is the embodied three powers, hundred-spike-bright-handed; victory: whose lotus-feet are worshipped, wishes accomplished by mere will.
Victory: bearer of a body beyond worlds, streaming a hundred beauties; victory: single-braided, Ganges-thinned, ash-seized.
Victory: smeared with milk-ocean-spread moonlight shade; victory: snow-ornamented with jewel-light risen from the Lord's limb-contact.
Victory: refuge like the one undying cool-rayed digit; victory: consecrated by ever-Ganges and universal lordship.
Victory: whose lowest-limb-touch purifies cowherds; victory: fixed-present where intoxicated devotees gather.
Victory: who dupes the childish, showing a hot place of His own will; victory: fit vessel for Gauri-embrace-fortune.
Victory: greedy for love-gifts wet with devotion-rasa; victory: pleased by the speech-dance of devotees drunk with devotion.
Victory: whose rise-and-fall is the power of Brahmā-and-first-gods; victory: whose command world-lord-rows bear on heads.
Victory: whose manifest glory is His seal set on all worlds; victory: great Lord of all, down to giving the very self.
Victory: secondless at the creation-wish moment; victory: with sole Goddess-helper bearing lordship's burden.
Victory: who seized all three worlds in one stride; victory: unbroken Lord-sound sung from childhood.
Victory: innately high, needing no pity and the rest; victory: Bhairava before whom great Death is made.
Victory: unopposed in fierce world-ending acts; victory: hundredfold-good-named recitation-following.
Victory: nectar-mine-ocean poured out in play; victory: whose instant anger dries the world-ending in a flash.
Victory: sole lamp of beings blind in delusion-darkness; victory: wakeful supreme Person while the sleeping world...
Victory: life-of-life humming inside the body-mountain cave; victory: best rasa sporting in good minds' sky.
Victory: mountain-lord born of high gold-ore; victory: moon rising as calamity-portent over the wicked.
Victory: hard to reach by austerity-tormented sages and gods; victory: seen by the world of devotion-madmen mounted on every state.
Victory: who leafed His dependents spreading His own wealth; victory: whose sole purpose is fondling surrendered people.
Victory: sole performer of creating-staying-destroying; victory: festival of the play-lotus blooming in drunken devotion.
Victory, worthy of victory! Victory, conqueror of birth, aging, dying! Victory, eldest of worlds... victory, victory... O three-eyed One.
